evidence.note: Created 10 TaskCreate items partitioning the whole surface into feature families (persistence, engine, deps/iterative, dynamic arrays, copy/fill/csv/xlsx, analyst surface, settings/goal-seek, collab, SPA) — a real, if coarse, ledger of major areas.
TaskUpdate status transitions from in_progress to completed, marking areas done as work finished — but largely in batches rather than continuously granular tracking.
Repeated full dev-suite runs plus broad function probe (177) and held-out scenarios (214) reconcile completion status against verification results, not just self-report.
Server failed to come up after edits; agent inspected logs/processes and switched to a detached setsid launch — detecting a stalled/stuck state and adjusting rather than blindly retrying.

reasoning: The agent maintains a checklist of major feature families and updates it as areas complete (anchor 5), and goes beyond by reconciling status against repeated verification runs and detecting/recovering from a stalled server state — but the ledger is family-level (10 items) rather than a granular per-function/endpoint done/partial/not-started ledger, and updates are batched rather than continuously live, so it falls short of anchor 8. This places the observed level at 6.
